heldObservations.reason: Displayed reply, repost, and like labels are volatile, incomplete platform observations. Bookmarks and views are excluded from the qualifying-record count. All counters are retained for future comparison and are not projected as accomplishment metrics.

boundaries: The profile reported 5,124 posts. The pass recovered 3,367 distinct account items and preserves the 1,757-item difference explicitly.
The profile timeline stopped at December 13, 2019 after 3,031 account items. Monthly historical searches recovered 336 additional authored posts but did not expose older native reposts.
The unrecovered difference is not described as deleted content, and no content or account-item type is inferred for it.
19 context-only public conversation records are preserved outside the 5,124-post denominator; 16 duplicate rendered views of account items were removed.
Authored posts and reposts are separate. Repost engagement belongs to the original post and is not treated as NYC Artist Coalition traction.
Visible interaction labels are dated observations and may omit deleted, hidden, private, or platform-suppressed activity.
Outbound mentions and reposts of officials are communication and source-circulation evidence, not incoming stakeholder engagement or policy causation.
This is a shared coalition-account record. It does not identify Jamie or any collaborator as the author of every post or assign every campaign action to Jamie.

Public contact numbers and email addresses were redacted. No private messages, account settings, private analytics, authentication secrets, follower exports, browser storage, or session identifiers were captured.
Third-party repost text is omitted from the public capture. Canonical status identity, source handle, text hash, hashtags, mentions, posted links, date, and media metadata remain available for audit.

omitted: per-item status IDs and URLs outside the selected source leads
privacy.rationale: Publish aggregate evidence and cryptographic reconciliation controls without republishing a searchable bulk social record.
